name: Srisawad Capital 1969 Public Company Limited
summary: Srisawad Capital 1969 Public Company Limited operates in Thailand, providing a comprehensive range of financial services. The company's core business involves commercial credit, offering short-term loans to assist with working capital requirements, in addition to long-term financing solutions for business expansion and capital investments, and also furnishing aval and guarantee facilities. Formerly known as Srisawad Finance Public Company Limited, the firm officially changed its name to Srisawad Capital 1969 Public Company Limited in September 2022. Established in 1969, its headquarters are located in Bangkok, Thailand.
